summary: BioKey (Cayman), Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its spin-off from ABVC BioPharma, Inc., effective August 21, 2026. ABVC distributed 4,500,390 ordinary shares, representing 15% of BioKey's outstanding shares, to ABVC stockholders as a pro rata dividend at a ratio of 0.169464 share per ABVC share. Post-distribution, ABVC retains 85% ownership. No trading market exists yet; BioKey plans to apply for OTC Markets quotation. The filing includes the final Information Statement and related agreements (Separation, TSA, Tax Matters, Employee Matters). Watch for OTC listing initiation and potential trading liquidity developments.
